visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Tags run off the screen
visualizerParams.problemDescription: On a phone these 120px chips do not wrap onto a second line. They run past the edge of the screen and the page scrolls sideways.

solution.explanation: With flex-wrap: nowrap all the items stay in one line and cannot shrink below their size, so the line is wider than the screen. flex-wrap: wrap lets the extra items continue on a new line.

checks.label: The chips wrap onto a second line
The page does not scroll sideways
